init_worker_worker: initialize a vLLM worker by resolving the worker class from a qualified name and constructing it with vllm_config
execute_model_worker: execute a model inference step on the worker given a scheduler output and return model runner output
compile_or_warm_up_model_worker: compile or warm up the model on the worker and return compilation times for language model and encoder
add_remove_lora_worker: add, remove, pin, and list LoRA adapters on the worker for dynamic model adaptation
init_device_worker: initialize the device state of the worker including loading the model and allocating on-device memory
